text:
Liz H: quick ping — opened a cleanup PR to tidy the import graph and split a couple of monolithic utils files. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/8423. Mostly moves and renames, no behavioral changes. Would appreciate extra eyeballs on import boundaries and any subtle circular deps. cc @Samir @Marta_G :pray:
Samir: thanks — I can take a look this afternoon. any hotspots I should check first?
Liz H: src/lib/formatting.ts and src/lib/index.ts are the trickiest, plus the new src/lib/validators/* split. imports around tokenizers might be surprising.
Marta G: I can skim for circular deps later tonight. quick question — are we keeping barrel exports for the public APIs?
Liz H: trying to remove the barrels for clarity — we expose a single facade in src/api/index.ts. barrels stayed for some internal bundles only.
Raj P: left a tiny inline about using named export instead of default in formatting.ts — default causes inconsistent import styles across the repo.
CI Bot: CI failed — lint error in src/lib/formatting.ts: line 42 trailing-comma. build log: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/8423/123
Liz H: fixing lint now, will push a small commit.
Samir: noted, I'll wait for green CI before doing a deeper pass.
Liz H: pushed fix: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/commit/1a2b3c4 — CI retriggered.
CI Bot: CI passed on commit 1a2b3c4 — all checks green :white_check_mark:
Samir: read through — LGTM aside from Raj's nit and one comment about a test missing for validator edge-case. can address the test in a follow-up if you prefer.
Marta G: glanced — approved from my side. no circular deps detected on a quick import-graph run.
Raj P: approved after the export nit.
Noah: small heads-up — release freeze in place until 17:00 PT today. if this touches runtime packaging, hold the merge. otherwise looks safe.
Liz H: thanks for the heads-up @Noah. this only affects dev utils and a couple of internal imports, not runtime packaging. I'll still hold for 30 mins to be safe.
Samir: fine with holding. ping me when you merge and I'll do a post-merge smoke test.
Liz H: ok, merging in ~30 once freeze lifts unless anyone objects. ty all for quick reviews :tada:
Liz H: merged in main at 1765126888 — no further changes.
Samir: thanks — running smoke tests now. all good on my end.
Marta G: thanks everyone.
